commands.text:
git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/03/**"
python tools/register_trustcpf_strong_series.py --stage 03 --check
python tools/reproduce.py materialize --line TRUST-CPF方案 --stage 03 --dest "$HOME/experiments/trust-03-replay"
cd "$HOME/experiments/trust-03-replay/trustcpf_modelcond_v1"
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

conda activate vgcpod_v1
cd "$HOME/czsl-research"
export CPF_REPO="$PWD"
git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/**"
python tools/reproduce.py materialize --line TRUST-CPF方案 --stage 03 --dest "$HOME/experiments/trust-03-replay"
export CPF_CACHE=/path/to/cache_ut_clip_l14
cd "$HOME/experiments/trust-03-replay/trustcpf_modelcond_v1"
python run.py setup --cache "$CPF_CACHE" \
  --source "$CPF_REPO/TRUST-CPF方案/02/results/raw_export/trustcpf_strong_v1"
source scripts/env.sh
"$CPF_PY" -m unittest discover -s tests -v

mkdir -p logs
nohup bash scripts/run_all.sh >> logs/queue.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
tail -F logs/queue.log

source scripts/env.sh
"$CPF_PY" run.py report
"$CPF_PY" scripts/check_complete.py
bash scripts/pack_results.sh

git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/03/**"
$cpfDestination = Join-Path $PWD "../trust-03-saved-archive"
python tools/register_trustcpf_strong_series.py --stage 03 --restore-archive "$cpfDestination"

git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/**"
python tools/analyze_trustcpf_strong_series.py --stage 03 --dest "$HOME/analysis/trust-03-recompute"
